keys.motion_arc_root_note: Rear foot owns mass; front foot is a range probe; guard already favors the incoming side.
keys.name: READY_REAR_BIASED

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis sinks and rotates behind the rear foot; guard shoulder meets the line while far arm and head lag.
keys.name: ASYM_BRACE_LOAD

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Right-to-left force folds guard side first; head and far arm lag while pelvis remains trapped over rear support.
keys.name: DIRECTIONAL_GUARD_CONTACT

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Spine folds around the loaded rear hip; front knee collapses inward; guard forearm trails the torso instead of moving as one block.
keys.name: DEEP_TORSION_COMPRESSION

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Front support peels while compression is still visibly stored: pelvis leads left/up, but head, chest, and guard remain folded for one decisive beat.
keys.name: FRONT_SUPPORT_PEELS

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis follows a shallow airborne arc left/up; distal arms remain behind, separating recoil from a rigid body slide.
keys.name: RECOIL_ARC_LIFT

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Torso and head overshoot the pelvis; guard-side hand remains behind to the right, making rotational recoil legible.
keys.name: TORSO_OVERSHOOT

keys.motion_arc_root_note: The body hangs at the displaced address after overshoot; limbs stay splayed and no foot is falsely declared trustworthy.
keys.name: CONSEQUENCE_HANG

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Rear foot arrests the root at a new address while the front foot remains untrusted and guard authority is still absent.
keys.name: TRUSTWORTHY_REAR_PLANT

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Plant sends torso back across the pelvis; front foot probes before it is promoted to support; arm catch-up stays late.
keys.name: COUNTERSWING_FRONT_PROBE

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Second support is earned before guard shape is restored; torso overshoots slightly through neutral and then settles.
keys.name: DUAL_SUPPORT_SETTLE

keys.motion_arc_root_note: Balance, support, facing, and guard authority rejoin at a new root address and a subtly tighter stance; recovery is not reverse playback.
keys.name: READY_REENTRY_OFFSET

principle: A guarded impact stores recoil debt in an asymmetrical brace; true hit reaction begins when support authority breaks, and recovery is a new path through overshoot, consequence hold, trustworthy plant, settle, and delayed guard re-entry.
